name: Godot Skill
headline: Godot Skill: Game Development & Export Automation
short_description: The Godot Skill allows users to develop and manage Godot 4.x games efficiently. It provides tools for unit testing, game automation, and web build exports.
author: randroids-dojo

sections.overview:
The Godot Skill provides AI agents with integrated tooling for Godot 4.x game development, testing, and deployment. It enables developers to automate unit testing, run game automation workflows, and export games to web platforms. The skill works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode, allowing you to leverage AI assistance for faster iteration cycles. Use it to streamline your Godot development pipeline from prototyping through production builds, reducing manual configuration and testing overhead.
Run unit tests using GdUnit4 framework
Automate game testing with PlayGodot
Export game builds for the web
Integrate with CI tools for continuous testing
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/randroids-dojo/skills --skill godot`
`git clone https://github.com/randroids-dojo/skills`
